label: pairwise_artist_signature_camera_composition_013
resolved_prompt: Compose one continuous single-view vertical image built around exactly one clearly adult woman as the only figure. Every visible face, body, and hand belongs to this same woman. Place a clearly visible strip of background above her entire hairstyle, and keep her complete crown, facial profile, and visible profile eye clearly readable. The second camera direction is the measured axis. Obey its literal crop, side view, field of view, asymmetric placement, and negative-space counterweight. Create a clean hand-drawn two-dimensional editorial illustration. The exact name-free signature controls the visible medium, face, eyes, silhouette, palette, light, composition, and ornament. Make these eight cues bold and unmistakable: line language—smooth rounded uninterrupted contours; face design—full rounded cheeks and a short nose; eye design—large layered irises and paired catchlights; body design—broad shoulders and athletic stable limbs; palette language—dark nocturnal blue with bright neon accents; light modeling—velvety diffuse values and soft contact shadows; framing language—a centered emblem-like outer border around the canvas, expressed in the background while the measured camera controls subject placement; ornament language—repeated fine floral lines. Draw face and eye details crisply within the waist-up figure. Put the ornament on both the garment and outer border. Keep the visible figure in front of every decorative framing element. Combine it coherently with this second visual direction: Photograph an adult subject using waist-up framing with complete hands whenever they enter the composition from a gently elevated camera position that reveals shoulder and floor relationships. The view uses long-lens compression with flattened depth and carefully separated silhouette edges and rule-of-thirds placement with open space extending in the direction of the gaze. Resolve both directions on the same adult subject. Give every named visual cue an obvious, concrete location on the face, clothing, silhouette, lighting, or environment. Preserve the selected medium and keep the face, eyes, visible hands, joints, garment construction, and spatial relationships coherent. Finish the single scene cleanly with text-free, logo-free, watermark-free imagery. Final camera lock—let the upper body fill most of the canvas from the complete crown to a lower edge crossing the garment immediately below the waist, with both described hand gestures inside while the thighs and feet continue beyond the canvas.
